cards.name: Shuffling Horror
textLines: Undulations: When the Shuffling Horror
uses this Skill, shuffle all Hero Stance
Cards together and put them back into
place at random, starting from the front.
Echoing Disassembly: If not all
Stance Slots for Monsters are filled,
Shuffling Horror will use this Skill. This
will summon a Cultist Priest (unless
it’s already in play) and Malignant
Growth (unless it’s already in play).
